pools.disjoint_from: task version 1.1's pools (101-260, 501-560), rule v3's pools (301-500, 601-680; opened by the selection on heap library version 2), rule v4's pools (701-1000; its selection opened 701-900 and 901-940) and the development seeds (1-100, 1001-1050)
pools.main_pool_work: every seed of the hidden main pool 1101-1200 is generated (gen A, archived); every seed whose qc.pass is true is generated again in a fresh process (gen B, not archived) and gets run a; the candidates passing every row but R7 get run b
pools.extension_use: only when the main pool holds no feasible 10-tuple (selection.hidden.rule, at the fallback tier in force): the extension 1201-1300 is generated whole; every seed that passes G gets gen B and run a, those passing every other row get run b; the used part = the whole extension (from then on, whichever pool the chosen set comes from)
pools.crash: a run that ends without its out.json (the process died: host load, memory) is started once more in a fresh process; a second failure makes the candidate not admissible ('run failed'); a run that ends normally is never repeated

admission.rule: a candidate is admissible when every row below holds; every row's value is written for every candidate in candidates_v2_0_v5/selection.json

rows.bytes: gen B (a fresh process, the same generator call, not archived) gives site.json, site.xml, qc.json and the side table byte-identical to gen A's, and run a's record carries gen A's archive sha256 (site_sha256) and gen A's site.json and site.xml sha256 (site_provenance)
rows.G: qc.json pass == true: G1-G24 as w4gen 0.3.0 defines and measures them: G1-G16 on the true site (G3 rendered), G9 and G17-G24 on all three counterfactual sites (each with its own rubble), G7c with --cf-render (camera rays and hit names, mission(), the public view including the heaps' records and collision bodies, and the classic renderer's RGB and depth frames identical over the three counterfactual sites), G20-G24 on the compiled model (class geometry: the placed rectangle inside the class's width and depth ranges, the compiled footprint inside it to within one placed cell (5 mm x scale) and the compiled top inside the class's range, for class R the edge rule >= 95 % along every exposed outline and the core rule, for class M (a natural toe, no edge rule) the compiled depth >= 0.28 m, the compiled gap to its line <= 0.05 m, the scale inside the registered interval and the piece's registered trial verdict true; gap promise < 0.15 m or >= 0.60 m; camera sees >= 0.70 of every heap and its top and no ray reaches under the slab; every heap's rectangle south of the slab front and its compiled footprint too except inside a floor box at least as high as the heap; 3-6 heaps with band A >= 1 and band B >= 2 and every heap against its line; the piece bound with the zero ring and max == size_z, the registry's fit line per class and the scale inside the registered interval). No repair, no re-draw.
rows.R1: run a: official score (task/tests/voidscore scorer_for(site, load_acceptance())) S == 1, F == 1, c == (1, 1, 1); summary.stuck_events == 0; summary.aborted is null
rows.R2: run a: summary.sim_time_s <= 1300 s (absolute cap). After the set is chosen: every selected site's run a time <= T / 1.6 (holds by the time-limit rule)
rows.R3: summary.n_prims in [111, 145]: rule v4's window, fixed in this rule as a constant (admission.R3_window). Rule v4 computed it once, before any of its run b, as [floor(P15), ceil(P85)], P = numpy.percentile (linear) of n_prims over run a of its 69 main-pool candidates (the hidden pool 701-800 and the practice first block 901-940) that passed bytes, G, R1, R2, R4, R5, R6 and R8 (both parts). This rule's pools are judged against it; it is not recomputed from them
rows.R4: summary.end_triangles == 0 and the set-down face (record.setdown.face_landed) is one of the six rollable faces (0,2,5) (0,3,5) (1,2,4) (1,2,5) (0,3,4) (1,3,4)
rows.R5: summary.n_blind_in >= 16 (the reference's count of the blind leg going in, the D8 wording)
rows.R6: summary.monitor.rod_pen_max_mm <= 5 (strut-axis penetration into any box record; for a heap the record is its rectangle from the floor to its top)
rows.R7: run b = a fresh process later, same archive, same episode seed, same arguments: record.final_state_sha256 equal to run a's; run b is made only for candidates passing every other row
rows.R8: two parts, both must hold in run a: (a) task version 1.1's wording: the reference never touches the under-slab rubble: the monitor's 10 Hz contact_box_samples summed over box names containing 'void_debris' == 0 AND contacts_every_tick.debris_ticks == 0; (b) the reference never touches a heap of the open floor: contacts_every_tick.box_names summed over geom names starting with 'heap__' == 0 (every control period) AND the monitor's 10 Hz contact_box_samples summed over names starting with 'heap__' == 0. Recorded per heap, not a row: the centre's and the nearest end cap's clearance to the heap's rectangle, its distance and side to each mouth

admission.values_recorded_not_rows: done_reason, inline score, internal errors, refused commands, illegal calls, the reference tree sha256 before and after each run (must be the pinned tree; a run on any other tree is void and the selection stops), primitive and void counts, true report distances, time split, per rubble block and per heap clearances, planner counts

text.rejection_records: R8 (b) and R3 both read the true mouth (the reference only drives to the true mouth) and act on visible heaps. Every candidate rejected by R8 (b) or by R3 gets one row in candidates_v2_0_v5/rejections_R8_R3.json: seed, the row(s) and their values (R3: n_prims and the window; R8 (b): the contact counts and which heap(s) the reference touched), every heap's class, rectangle, top, and per mouth the distance from the heap's rectangle to the mouth's opening (the segment [x0, x1] at the slab front), the side (west / east of the mouth's centre) and whether that mouth is the true one. Summary table: among the candidates rejected by R8 (b), those rejected by R3 and the admissible ones, the count and share whose heap nearest to any mouth opening is nearest to the true mouth (chance 1/3), with the two-sided exact binomial p against 1/3 and Fisher's exact p of each rejected group against the admissible group. Recorded, not a gate (the cue check on the admissible pool is the gate).

G_d_pool.name: pool-level blind-leg table check (G_d)
G_d_pool.pool: the candidates of the used part of this rule's hidden pool (the main pool 1101-1200, or the main pool plus the whole extension 1201-1300 once the extension is generated) that pass every G row (qc.pass) and R1, run a, plus the 20 such candidates of rule v4's practice first block 901-940 (rule v4's definition of the pool, unchanged; the 20 rows as rule v4's gd_pool.json has them, pinned below: recomputed from the carried-over raw results they must be equal, else stop and report)
G_d_pool.measure: task version 1.1's wording, unchanged: the blind leg going in = the executed primitives with t_start >= the counted point-2 report time and t_end <= the counted point-3 report time; start = the truth pose at the end of the last primitive of that leg whose truth centre end has y <= params.y2 + 0.10 (if none, the start of the leg); the handbook's table (the GENERATED primitive_table block of task/environment/setup/payload/given/robot_handbook.md; the block's bytes are pinned below under inputs_pinned_blocks_sha256, the rest of that file is no input of this rule) chained over every primitive after that boundary up to the point-3 report, with the name and bottom face the reference passed, the mean step only; the end = the truth pose at the end of the leg's last primitive. Score 1 when the chained end is within 0.20 m of the truth end. Statistic = the share of 1 over the pool. Every candidate's row is recorded; no candidate is screened by it.
G_d_pool.self_check_before_the_pool_number: the same code reproduces 15 / 42 on the 42 admitted W4 development sites' reference runs (the reference check before this rule); a miss is a bug of the implementation (fixed and recorded), not a reason to change this text
G_d_pool.consequence_fixed_in_advance: share <= 0.35: holds; the selection goes on as usual. 0.35 < share <= 0.50: recorded and continued: the share is written into the readout amendment and the quote, the selection goes on by this rule without asking. share > 0.50: no selection, no time limit, nothing handed on; the packages and the reference results stay as they are; the per-candidate table goes to the task's maintainers the same day.
G_d_pool.forbidden: screening sites by the table-only error; changing the 0.35 line

strata.read_from: the generated site.json: third = r1.third (gap_T / gap_XN / slot_XL); corner = stratum.corner (E / W); near_rank = stratum.near_rank (0 near / 1 middle / 2 far: rank of the true mouth by |x - x3|); roof = r1.tunnel_roof (flat / lean); true_index = stratum.true_index (0 / 1 / 2 = west / middle / east); shape = stratum.shape; heap_group = '3-4' when heaps.n <= 4 else '5-6'; heaps_R, heaps_M = heaps.by_class

hidden.rule: the hidden set is the lexicographically smallest feasible 10-tuple: every set of 10 admissible candidates of the search set, written as its seeds in ascending order, is a 10-tuple; feasible = it meets every quota (quotas_max) and every minimum (set_minimums at the fallback tier in force, heap_totals_min) at once; the set is the feasible 10-tuple that is lexicographically smallest. Search sets, in this order: the admissible candidates of the main pool 1101-1200 alone; only when no feasible 10-tuple exists there, the extension 1201-1300 is generated whole and run (pools.extension_use) and the search set is the admissible candidates of the main pool plus the extension. Found by the backtracking search that takes, slot by slot in seed order, the smallest seed after which the admissible candidates with larger seeds can still complete every quota and minimum (decided exactly, by a memoized search with each minimum's count capped at its threshold). The set is decided only when no candidate of the search set is pending (passing G with its admission not yet decided): any pending seed, small or large, can change the smallest feasible 10-tuple. Episode order h01..h10 = the set in seed order.

fallback_tiers.when: no feasible 10-tuple at the rule's own minimums (tier 0) in the main pool plus the extension
no feasible 10-tuple at tier 1 in the main pool plus the extension
no feasible 10-tuple at tier 2 in the main pool plus the extension
fallback_tiers.action: stop and report to the task's maintainers

hidden.fallback_tiers_read: tier 0 = set_minimums above; a tier's set_minimums replace only the levels it names (every other quota, minimum and heap total stays as above); each tier is searched in the order of the rule (the main pool's admissible candidates alone first, then the main pool plus the extension's), with the same lexicographic definition; the selection record names the tier used

practice.rule: not chosen again: rule v4's triple 903, 907, 919 (p1..p3 in seed order) is carried over. Rule v4 chose it by this rule's three constraints above as the first feasible triple in seed order (the three admissible practice candidates whose sorted seed list is lexicographically smallest among all triples meeting them) over its first block 901-940; the selection tool checks again that this definition gives the same triple on the carried-over rows of 901-940

fallback: 1. extension: no feasible 10-tuple in the main pool: the extension 1201-1300 is generated whole and run (pools.extension_use) and the search set is the main pool plus the extension; no hand picking

2. fallback tier 1: no feasible 10-tuple in the main pool plus the extension: the minimum 'sites with 5-6 heaps >= 3' is lowered to >= 2 (selection.hidden.fallback_tiers), searched in the same order (the main pool alone first, then the main pool plus the extension) with the same lexicographic definition
3. fallback tier 2: still none: that minimum is lowered to >= 1, searched in the same order
4. still none: stop and report to the task's maintainers; no other admission row, quota or minimum is relaxed and this rule is not changed

set_level_checks.hidden: true mouth west / middle / east each >= 2; tunnel roof flat / lean each >= 4; sites with 3-4 heaps >= 3 and sites with 5-6 heaps >= the minimum of the fallback tier in force (3, 2 or 1); heaps of class R and of class M each >= 12 (checked again); reported: near / middle / far counts, corners, thirds, shapes, heap counts and the count k of sites where the mouth nearest SP3 is the true one (blind guessing Binomial(10, 1/3): P(k >= 6) = 0.077, P(k >= 7) = 0.020)
set_level_checks.disjoint: hidden and practice seeds disjoint; the 13 selected packages' site.json sha256 pairwise distinct and site.xml sha256 (the geometry) pairwise distinct; none equals a site.json or site.xml of task version 1.1's 13 frozen packages (task version 1.1/tests/hidden/sites/h01-h10, task version 1.1/environment/practice_ground/sites/p1-p3, pinned below), a W4 development package (the development batches' file hashes, pinned below), a candidate package of rule v3's selection on heap library version 2 (its 173 candidates, the 13 selected among them: maintainer/build/candidates_v2_0/INDEX.json, pinned below), a candidate package of rule v4's selection (its 240 candidates: maintainer/build/candidates_v2_0_lib3/INDEX.json, pinned below) other than the three practice sites carried over from it (903, 907, 919), a W3 development package, or the calibration site package's members (task/environment/practice_ground/cal/cal.tar.xz as it is at the selection; the freeze checks the calibration package it freezes again); the hidden seeds are disjoint from task version 1.1's pools, rule v3's pools and rule v4's pools (701-1000) by construction; the practice seeds are rule v4's
set_level_checks.failure: a failed set-level check: stop and report; the rule is not changed

cue_check.tool: maintainer/tools/select/cue_check_w4.py (task version 1.1's check plus the heaps' features)
cue_check.features: per site and per mouth (m1, m2, m3 in r2.order), computed from what an agent can know without the truth: the mission, the search camera (1 x 1 rays with the true camera pose: hit geometry and positions; the classic render with the site's light) and the boxes and heaps a ray reaches. Task version 1.1's features unchanged (widths, heights, supports, distances to walls, pad, SP1-SP3 and the ridge openings; counts and nearest distances of crates, ridge blocks and chips within 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 m; gravel and dust cover; image pixels, depths and mean luminances of the aperture, the floor in front, the flanks, the zone and the face; the zone's highest point; pixels per kind) plus, for the heaps: the distance from the mouth's front point to the nearest heap; heaps within 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 m; whether a heap's rectangle meets the 0.60 m floor strip west / east of the mouth's apron (and either); the nearest heap's class and top height; band-B heaps whose x-range meets the mouth's x-range +- 0.30 m; the site's heap counts (all, R, M); heap pixels in the mouth's zone
cue_check.rules: for every feature f: 'enter the mouth with the largest f' and 'enter the mouth with the smallest f' (ties to the first in row order m1 < m2 < m3), plus 'always m1 / m2 / m3'; rules with the same choice on every site counted once
cue_check.pools: gate pool A = every admissible candidate of the used part of this rule's hidden pool (the main pool, or the main pool plus the whole extension once it is generated) plus the 16 admissible candidates of rule v4's practice first block 901-940 (their feature rows as rule v4's cue_features.jsonl has them, pinned below: recomputed they must be equal, else stop and report); gate set B = the 13 selected sites (this rule's 10 hidden and rule v4's 3 practice). Reading only: every G-passing candidate of the used part and of the practice first block
cue_check.test: per rule: hits = sites where it picks the true mouth; two-sided exact binomial test against 1/3. Family-wise: the label-permutation null (the true mouth redrawn uniformly per site, 20000 draws, seed 2026112004): position of the best rule's |hits - n/3| in the null distribution of the maximum over all rules = the permutation p
cue_check.gate: on A and on B: permutation p > 0.05 and no rule with Bonferroni-adjusted p (raw p x number of distinct rules) <= 0.05. Reported in addition: every rule's raw p, every rule with raw p <= 0.05 (a reading), the best rule, and a leak control that reads the truth (the hidden boxes' nearest distance), which must be detected
cue_check.failure: stop; find the visible quantity that carries the truth and take it back to the generator; the set is not changed to remove it
